"""Run through official execute_python after final render terminal."""
import bpy,json,hashlib,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from dcc_mcp_blender import _render_job_ops as jobs
root=Path('EVIDENCE_ROOT/houdini-blender-final')
job=json.loads((root/'render-submission.json').read_text())['context']['job_id']
j=jobs._JOBS[job]
assert j['process'].poll()==0,'Require completed and exited owned render worker'
p=root/'artifacts/frames/frame_0001.exr'
im=None;tmp=None
try:
 im=bpy.data.images.load(str(p),check_existing=False)
 tmp=bpy.data.scenes.new('HoudiniCrossDCCEXRReadbackOnly');tmp.use_nodes=True
 node=tmp.node_tree.nodes.new('CompositorNodeImage');node.image=im
 outputs=[s.name for s in node.outputs]
 assert 'Denoising Normal' in outputs and 'Denoising Albedo' in outputs
 report={'worker_returncode':j['process'].poll(),'true_passes':True,'pass_names':outputs,'beauty_full_decode':False,'auxiliary_decode_scope':'Native node exposes actual AOVs; full selected-pass decode pending official denoise backend. Image.pixels is unavailable for this multilayer EXR.','sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
 (root/'final_source_verified.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2));print(json.dumps(report))
finally:
 if tmp is not None:bpy.data.scenes.remove(tmp)
 if im is not None:bpy.data.images.remove(im)
